extension/src/panel.webview.test.ts.reason: Real progressive workers must deliver bounded recovery and metadata through the production panel host. Start metadata must survive storage delays, hidden panels, preference resets, and reloads. File presses and Open the changes must preserve recorded parent and subagent changes after their worktree disappears. Commit presses must never open an unrelated repository after their worktree disappears. Reader sends must release held compaction after drops without overtaking surviving input. Each Prompt box must retain its supplying child definition across sibling catalogs, idle updates, and child replacement. The Remote Control item must follow connection results and never reach saved drafts. Row posts and watcher decisions must reach the performance counters with their causes through the production host methods. A catalog refresh must name why it could not reuse the held catalog. A catalog refresh must admit settled sessions without a file check after a walk or with the held catalog, and recheck moved or replaced ones. Each prompt admission file check must name its cause. One spend update must check each child file once and publish dispatched costs once, and an integrity check that queues nothing must not publish them. The query context revision must follow both memberships as a short digest. A prompt box send must reach its session through a repository scope walk only while the latest walk under the current roots holds the same source, and every return to the box must say why. A background Claude subagent that discovery has not listed must read running while its own file is fresh, and no ending recorded when that file is stale, missing, or beside a copied parent. A Prompt box submission to an agent run must reach the next posted session list as the reader's own on every path that queues it or that the agent accepts, and a refused or local submission must leave the run filed as one.

extension/src/startup.test.ts.reason: Real title workers must publish recovered metadata through startup ownership and cancellation boundaries. Project cost snapshots must preserve workspace, revision, and calendar ownership during background slices. Agent messages must preserve durable admission, settlement wakeups, native delivery authority, and retained retries. Host integrity checks must preserve complete cost, discovery membership, exact revisions, and bounded coverage across failures and panel lifecycle changes. Ordinary corrections must cross CLI parsing and the authenticated channel before busy target work finishes, preserving native receipts, reservations, and final admission. Pending ordinary receipts retain target exclusion across caller disconnect and wake eligible queued heads only after settlement. Startup measurements must accept baselines that already block agents. A discovery progress reply before an accepted catalog must keep the walked rows for the next reuse. A session this panel started must publish its name and recorded responses from a real worker read while relationship discovery stays pending. Discovery continuations must run without a catalog refresh until a reply completes or changes the listed sessions. A session row must follow a transcript that grew after the accepted catalog while relationship discovery continues. A selection must check prompts and build session list rows only for each panel's current and previous session. A selected session with a dispatched child must reuse its newest turn after one real worker read. A repository scope change must leave a discovery continuation in flight running. A poll at unchanged directories, live child events, a new child transcript under a listed session and a selected draft must keep the held catalog, while a moved directory, the backstop and a replaced named transcript walk.
